notes: Word64 addition wraps modulo 2^64; bang patterns keep both running values evaluated, so no thunks pile up.
word64Dec renders each number straight into the output buffer: the Builder is consumed by hPutBuilder as it is produced, in constant memory.
The argument is checked to be ASCII digits before read parses it as an unbounded Integer, so huge inputs cannot overflow.
ghc -O2 with the non-threaded RTS; fully static (glibc, GMP) and stripped, on a scratch image.
